chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Emma Priestly, his first wife
summary: He corrects the record: Emma, whom he met at the Cotton Club as a teenager, was his first wife and Toni his second.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah. Sebastian was still the owner of it. And he had some wild shows in there, you know. They had all the prettiest chorus girls they could find -- all stacked, of course. [LAUGHS] That happened to be where I met my first wife, Emma, who is the mother of my oldest daughter, Sylvia.
Well, on this earlier occasion you referred to Toni as your first wife.
My second wife, yeah. This one happened when I was a teenager. I really wasn't old enough to get married, but I did.
Priestly. Didn't I mention that before?
No. Your marital life started with Toni, according to the tape so far...
...Emma. But we were both so young, until it was... I'd advise all young people to wait a while. Never get married too early. Live a little bit. Because you've got to do it sooner or later anyhow.
